title: EU Inspection
longDescription: EU inspection checks the vehicle's traffic safety and environmental impact through approximately 150 control points
pricingDescription: Complete EU inspection with approximately 150 control points, direct connection with the Norwegian Public Roads Administration

title: Re-inspection
description: If you have made repairs in connection with a failed EU Inspection
longDescription: We go through the car to see that the faults discovered during the EU inspection have been repaired.
pricingDescription: Re-inspection of repairs made in connection with a failed EU Inspection

title: 4-Wheel Alignment
description: Control and adjustment of wheel alignment angle.
longDescription: Precise wheel alignment for optimal safety and tire life.
pricingDescription: Control and adjustment of wheel alignment angle on your car

title: Service
description: Oil change and several other service options - choose what suits your car.
longDescription: Regular service is crucial for engine life and performance. When booking, you choose between several service options, from a simple oil change to more comprehensive service. We use quality oils and filters for optimal protection.
features: Several service options to choose from when booking
pricingDescription: Oil change with oil, filter and labor from approx. 2000,-. Price depends on service option, car type and oil type

title: A/C Service
description: Pressure test, diagnosis and refill of refrigerant on your car's A/C system.
longDescription: We pressure test and diagnose your A/C system, and refill refrigerant if needed. Note that we can only service A/C systems using R134a refrigerant, not the newer R1234yf type.
pricingDescription: 1500,- for pressure test/diagnosis, plus 3,- per gram of refrigerant refilled. Only for vehicles using R134a refrigerant (not the newer R1234yf).

title: Car Diagnostics
description: Advanced diagnostics for identifying car problems.
longDescription: Modern diagnostic equipment and good old-fashioned mechanic experience for quick identification of car and system problems.
features: Testing of car systems and performance

title: Tire Service
description: Complete tire service - mounting, balancing, fitting and repairs.
longDescription: Good prices on tires and services, large suppliers with many different tire manufacturers and dimensions that can be obtained at short notice. We also offer balancing with digital equipment for precise adjustment and tire fitting on your rims.
pricing: From 250 kr for rotation, 150 kr for mounting per tire, 1000 kr for balancing (500 kr for loose wheels)

title: Tire Change
description: Tire change between summer and winter tires.
longDescription: Quick tire change with hydraulic jack

title: Tire Hotel
description: Safe storage of summer and winter tires.
longDescription: Practical storage with washing and tire change when you need it.
pricingDescription: Simple and safe storage of your tires when you switch over for the season

title: Car Repairs
description: Maintenance and repairs with very competitive hourly rates.
longDescription: Transparent prices and broad experience with different car types and manufacturers. We can handle everything from small repairs to major maintenance work.
pricingDescription: Our competitive hourly rate for workshop work and repairs
